// diagnostic E0514

Jet.MutableNeverReassigned

`{name}` never changes, so declare it with `:`

What

`{name}` never changes, so declare it with `:`

Why

`:=` tells the reader the value changes later, but nothing in its scope writes it

Fix

Write `{name}: …` instead of `{name} := …`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MutableNeverReassigned: Tests/UI/E0514_generic_module_body_points_at_binding.stderr.

Warning: Jet.MutableNeverReassigned: `count` never changes, so declare it with `:`
  --> Tests/UI/E0514_generic_module_body_points_at_binding.jet:7:10
    |
  7 |         ^count: start
    |          ^^^^^
 Why: `:=` tells the reader the value changes later, but nothing in its scope writes it
 Fix: Write `count: …` instead of `count := …`
